capabilities.name: Multilayer PCB surfaces
capabilities.scope: 2-16 copper layers; selected nets, rectangular rigid board; no multilayer vias

capabilities.name: Per-layer dielectric materials and loss
capabilities.scope: Explicit constant relative permittivity; optional imported loss tangent

capabilities.name: Lumped ports
capabilities.scope: One or two aligned pad pairs on adjacent layers, explicit reference impedance

capabilities.name: Absorbing air boundary
capabilities.scope: Finite air region with optional explicit margin; requires convergence review

capabilities.name: Manual copper and port mesh sizing
capabilities.scope: Bounded requested copper resolution and port face refinement

capabilities.name: Solved S-parameter frequency sweep
capabilities.scope: 2-64 direct solved samples; no vector-fit interpolation

capabilities.name: Parallel frequency sweep
capabilities.scope: Optional 1-8 runtime workers; availability depends on selected runtime API

capabilities.name: Far-field cuts and 3D patterns
capabilities.scope: Configurable bounded angular sampling; relative normalization only

capabilities.name: Electric and magnetic field plane
capabilities.scope: Optional XY grid with complex E/H samples and explicit invalid-point mask

capabilities.name: Touchstone and CSV export
capabilities.scope: Exports returned complex network data at its stated reference impedance

capabilities.name: EMCAD copper geometry
capabilities.scope: Optional same-net, same-layer union; holes rejected

capabilities.name: Dielectric surroundings
capabilities.scope: Up to eight explicit non-overlapping boxes

capabilities.name: Readable Python model
capabilities.scope: GUI preview/export matches the generated script used by the contained runner

capabilities.name: SPIKE analysis, probes and reports
capabilities.scope: Sampled network and angular/field review with model status and provenance

capabilities.name: General CAD primitives, booleans and transforms
capabilities.scope: Requires neutral volume/face selection and an EMerge CAD adapter

capabilities.name: Perfectly matched layers
capabilities.scope: Requires explicit volume assignments and thickness validation

capabilities.name: Waveguide, coaxial and modal wave ports
capabilities.scope: Requires face geometry and mode selection contracts

capabilities.name: Periodic and Floquet ports
capabilities.scope: Requires paired-face periodic-cell contract

capabilities.name: PMC and symmetry planes
capabilities.scope: Requires boundary face selection and symmetry validation

capabilities.name: Surface impedance and thin metal
capabilities.scope: Requires conductor/material model and boundary contracts

capabilities.name: Lumped elements
capabilities.scope: Requires circuit-to-face mapping

capabilities.name: Adaptive mesh refinement
capabilities.scope: Requires error/convergence admission and bounded refinement lifecycle

capabilities.name: Optimization and geometry parameter sweeps
capabilities.scope: Requires geometry parameter ownership and result comparison contracts

capabilities.name: Dispersive and tensor materials
capabilities.scope: Requires material tensor, frequency and coordinate validity contracts

capabilities.name: Upstream material library
capabilities.scope: Requires provenance and verification of individual library properties

capabilities.name: Vector fitting
capabilities.scope: Requires separately identified fitted network and error/passivity evidence

capabilities.name: Eigenmode studies
capabilities.scope: Requires eigenmode excitation, units and mode-shape result contracts

capabilities.name: Scattered-field and radar cross section
capabilities.scope: Requires incident-wave setup and absolute scattering result contract

capabilities.name: Heat conduction and one-way coupling
capabilities.scope: Requires thermal boundaries and transferred-loss validity contracts

capabilities.name: Alternate CPU/GPU direct solvers
capabilities.scope: Requires runtime discovery and explicit supported solver selection
